Swadhin Bangla Betar engr Rashidul dies
2015-12-22T11:22:47+06:00 | UNB, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/news/swadhin-bangla-betar-engr-rashidul-dies-190933

Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra sound engineer Rashidul Hossain died at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University Hospital early today. He was 72. Rashidul breathed his last at the intensive care unit of the hospital around 3:15am, said Brigadier General (Retd) Abdul Majid Bhuinyan, director of the hospital. The language hero had been undergoing treatment at the ICU since December 19 due to old-age complications.
